SELECT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.file_dependencies fd ON s.file_id = fd.importer_file_id
JOIN code.calls c ON s.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
WHERE s.file_id = 'tests/client/test_redirects.py'
  AND s.kind = 'function'
  AND s.is_public = false
  AND c.call_kind = 'callback'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols target
             WHERE target.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
               AND target.name = 'redirects')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code.symbols client
             WHERE client.qualname = 'httpx.AsyncClient'
               AND client.file_id = s.file_id)
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.call_id) > 0
